children: Austin, Texas, United States, September 18th, 2026, FinanceWire
VERAXA has appointed Raju Willener as Chief Financial Officer, effective immediately.
Willener brings more than 30 years of international experience spanning investment banking, corporate finance, asset management and capital markets.
His appointment comes as VERAXA advances its proprietary BiTAC platform and a pipeline centered on antibody-drug conjugates and T-cell engagers.
VERAXA has reported encouraging early data for its BiTAC technologies, including an in-vitro proof of concept for its BiTAC-ADC platform.

, an emerging leader in designing novel cancer therapies, has appointed Raju Willener as chief financial officer, adding a finance executive with more than three decades of international capital-markets experience as the biotechnology company works to advance its oncology pipeline. The appointment is effective immediately. Willener will report to Chief Executive Officer and co-founder Christoph Antz, Ph.D. (https://ibn.fm/Eibml).
